name: Robert Clive
contribution: As an East India Company commander, he led Company forces at Plassey and used alliances with Bengal’s court factions to expand British influence.
context: His Bengal career centered on the 1757 Battle of Plassey, the Company’s acquisition of revenue rights after 1765, and the military-political expansion that followed.
impact: Clive’s victory at Plassey and subsequent political settlements helped shift Bengal from a regional court contested by European companies toward Company-dominated rule.
highlight: The Company commander whose victory at Plassey accelerated British political power in Bengal.
seoTitle: Robert Clive and Bengal: Plassey and Company Power
seoDescription: Learn how Robert Clive’s victory at Plassey and later Company settlements accelerated British political control in eighteenth-century Bengal.
shortAnswer: Robert Clive was an East India Company commander whose 1757 victory at Plassey helped accelerate Company political control in Bengal.
